text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the token-validation postmortem — we sketched remediation last week but need tighter ownership and a cadence for audits. Can we lock down owners and timelines here?

maria: +1. I created a short checklist in the doc: https://internal.redwood/proj/sec/postmortem-token-validate (see section 'remediation sprint'). Propose: weekly check-ins for 6 weeks, then monthly audits.

sam: Sounds reasonable. For clarity: who owns rotating the service tokens vs. validating the client-side checks?

jen: I can take service token rotation (monthly). Will add runbook steps and a one-click script.

kevin: I'll own validation tests and audit logging changes. Plan: write tests to assert 401 handling and add structured audit events to token service. ETA: two weeks for initial PRs.

alex: Great — jen (rotation) and kevin (validation + logging). Maria to track overall spike. Can we list concrete action items with owners + due dates here?

maria: Action items: 1) Rotate service tokens and add rotation script — owner: jen — due: 2025-05-10. 2) Add end-to-end token validation tests + add audit events schema — owner: kevin — due: 2025-05-17. 3) Add CI gate to fail on missing audit events for auth calls — owner: sam — due: 2025-05-24. 4) Run one-off tenant audit for drift and report — owner: alex — due: 2025-05-12.

sam: I can take CI gate. Quick Q: where should the audit-events live? Logging infra or a separate audit store?

kevin: Prefer a separate audit index in ES with minimal retention for prod, plus a forwarder to long-term S3 for compliance. I'll draft schema: fields(token_id, user_id, action, outcome, timestamp, request_id).

jen: Rotation script sketch (will put in repo under infra/scripts):
```bash
# rotate a service token for svc-auth
kubectl -n infra get secret svc-auth-token -o yaml | 
  some-tool rotate-secret --apply
```
I'll also wire up a one-line smoke test to validate the new token before cutover.

alex: Good. Two other items: (a) Confirm KMS used for all token material and update ownership table; (b) set recurring calendar reminder for monthly rotation.

maria: (a) KMS ownership: security-ops currently. I will ping them and update the ownership doc. (b) I'll create a recurring calendar invite for the rotation reminder after jen's PR merges.

incident-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-3245 (remediation: token validation & rotation) and linked to PM ticket PM-1983.

sam: One more: we saw a recurring pattern of 401 spikes during midnight batch windows. Could be stale tokens or clock skew. Recommend we add monitoring alert: >10% 401s for 5m triggers an oncall page. owner: sam, due: 2025-05-05.

kevin: I will add trace points to correlate 401s with token issuance times and TTL. Might reveal drift.

jen: Will include a 'dry run' toggle in the rotation script so we can validate across clusters without breaking live services.

alex: Thanks all. Maria — please keep this thread as canonical follow-up. Please post weekly status updates here (short 1-2 line).

maria: Will do. Weekly update schedule: every Monday 10am until 2025-06-15. First status posted next Monday. :calendar: :spiral_calendar: 

sam: FYI I scheduled a 30m sync for tomorrow to triage the 401 spikes with infra. Invite sent.

alex: Ack. Closing action assignment for now. If owners need to reassign, ping here. :thumbsup:
